tools.name: search
tools.description: Use first for any question on crypto source of funds, stolen or frozen crypto, blockchain evidence and expert reports, crypto tax, crypto regulation (MiCA, Travel Rule, FINMA, SRO, CARF, DAC8) or data protection in Switzerland. Searches Advisorn's questions and answers, glossary and insights in Engl

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Returns the full text of one of Advisorn's questions and answers (short answer, sections, legal references, related questions, page link), by id from search or list_topics.

tools.name: get_term
tools.description: Returns Advisorn's definition of a term (e.g. source-of-funds, kyt, peel-chain, issuer-freeze, party-appointed-expert, mica, travel-rule, carf, fadp) with explanation, related questions and page link.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Lists all of Advisorn's questions and answers by topic and all glossary terms by group, with ids and links. Use when search finds nothing or to show what is covered.

tools.name: about_advisorn
tools.description: Facts about Advisorn GmbH: what it does, for whom, where, languages, managing partner, contact and main pages. Use when the user asks who Advisorn is or whether it can help.

tools.name: start_request
tools.description: When the user wants Advisorn's help with their own case, returns the link that opens the right request form on advisorn.com (about one minute, the person fills it in; a non-disclosure agreement can be requested there). Sends nothing and stores nothing. Areas: sof (source of funds report), inv (stole

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
